sources.prompt: Create a production texture source sheet for a serious dark woodland merchant UI, flat orthographic material swatches, exactly FOUR equally sized SQUARE swatches in a precise 2x2 grid, no gaps, no borders, no labels, no symbols. Square canvas. TOP LEFT: near black charcoal paper #1b1a17, subtle handmade paper grain and sparse worn printing ink, low contrast and quiet enough behind text. TOP RIGHT: very dark weathered walnut wood #2a241d, horizontal long coarse grain with a little umber #5a4632, matte, no plank joins. BOTTOM LEFT: faded oxblood red #8f2f24 linocut ink band over rough paper, flat rich ink and sparse rubbed gouge marks, restrained grain. BOTTOM RIGHT: subdued aged brass #87734f, flat tarnished metal surface, no shiny highlights, no rivets, no objects. All four fill their quadrants completely edge to edge. Handcrafted woodcut print surface quality, serious forest war equipment, no gradients, no lighting, no glow, no illustration, no text. Each quadrant uniformly lit and locally tileable; no corner shading. This is raw high-resolution material to cut and build clean 9-slice UI pieces with.

A single isolated upper-left CORNER ORNAMENT for a reusable serious woodland game UI frame, transparent background, square image. Orthographic flat front view, no perspective. An L shaped dark walnut wood corner, two equal arms extending rightward and downward, outer corner square, uniform thick rails. A small matte tarnished brass L bracket with three functional rivets joins the corner. ONLY FOUR small ivy leaves in muted moss green near the elbow, sparse and asymmetrical, do not fill the empty center; all decoration contained inside the corner's square footprint. Carved woodgrain and coarse linocut printed strokes, charcoal black, dark umber, bone flecks, muted brass, olive ivy. The two straight arms terminate in clean perpendicular square cuts. No shadows outside the silhouette, no backing plate, no floor, no text, no lettering, no glow, no bevel shine, no cartoon. Production cutout of a robust hand-made dark wood/brass UI corner. Entire corner fully visible with generous transparent padding.

Production icon source atlas on true transparent background, square canvas, EXACTLY NINE isolated glyphs in a strict equal 3 by 3 grid, each centered in its own equal cell, ample transparent padding, no touching cells, NO borders or circular badges. Bone colored #d9cfb6 hand-carved linocut / woodcut silhouettes, a few dark umber carved cuts, very bold simplified forms readable at 24 pixels, serious weathered woodland military workshop aesthetic, matte flat 2D shapes, no perspective shadows, no glow, no photoreal detail. ROW ONE left to right: simple CLOSE X made of two broad crossed strokes; closed padlock with heavy arched shackle; bold CHECK MARK. ROW TWO left to right: simple shopping CART with two circular wheels; magnifying glass SEARCH glyph; broad funnel FILTER glyph. ROW THREE left to right: portable radio direction-finding SENSOR receiver with three prong antenna and large round dial; SUPPLY crate suspended under a clearly visible rounded PARACHUTE with four cords; crossed HAMMER and PLIERS for CRAFTING with readable tool silhouettes. Keep every glyph entirely contained in its cell, all scales balanced. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers. Palette bone on transparent ONLY, delicate distressed ink holes inside broad shapes, no black filled backdrop.

Create ONE extremely wide panoramic decorative band for a dark woodland merchant game interface, exact requested shape 2048 wide by 320 high (6.4:1). Continuous horizontal hand-carved woodcut forest panorama, designed to repeat seamlessly left-to-right, matching tree silhouettes and ground height at both left and right edges. Charcoal #1b1a17 background, muted bone #c8b98f and umber #5a4632 printed trees; only two restrained ink values. Dark serious weathered forest-war mood. Large readable fir silhouettes, a few rough fallen branches, distant wooded ridges and one tiny patched woodland shelter near right-middle, strong carved gouge cuts. Horizontal composition all artwork fits the shallow band, no cropping of tree tops. At both extreme sides trees of equal height and shape to allow seamless repeat. Flat linocut print, no photographic or painterly rendering, no glow, no sky gradients, no sun or moon, no border, no frame, no lettering, no symbols, no watermark. Low overall contrast so this remains secondary header decoration. Edge-to-edge full bleed.
